# Next Button

Call-to-action buttons in 12 current-generation designs from the Next Collection, covering motion (border beam, shimmer sweep, rainbow glow, pulse ring), depth (mechanical keycap, layered stack, magnetic float), bold aesthetics (neo-brutal, clay, holographic foil) and smart shape changes (icon that morphs into a label, hold-to-confirm fill). Motion designs adapt Magic UI's shimmer, rainbow, pulsating and border-beam buttons; every color is resolved from the Universal Theme palette so the buttons follow Vita, Vita Dark, Redwood and Theme Roller. Report mode renders a wrapping action bar.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_NEXT_BUTTON` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/nextButton` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Based on | [Magic UI](https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui) (MIT) |

Use for one or two prominent calls to action per page and keep native Universal Theme buttons for ordinary form actions. Set Link to render an anchor; without a link a button is rendered for a Dynamic Action. Map Color to a column returning primary, success, warning, danger or info (anything else renders as primary). Hint is short secondary text: the shortcut legend on Keycap, the instruction under the label on Confirm hold, a small trailing tag elsewhere. Every design has hover, pressed and keyboard focus states, and all motion stops under reduced motion.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | selectList (`borderBeam`, `shimmer`, `rainbowGlow`, `pulseRing`, `keycap`, `layered`, `magnetic`, `neoBrutal`, `clay`, `holo`, `morphIcon`, `confirmHold`) | yes | `borderBeam` | The button design and its Next Collection direction. Motion: Border beam, Shimmer, Rainbow glow, Pulse ring. Depth: Keycap presses down like a mechanical key, Layered separates a stack of plates on hover, Magnetic floats and follows the pointer. Bold: Neo-brutal, Clay, Holo foil. Smart: Morph icon is an icon circle that expands into its label on hover or focus and stays expanded on touch screens; Confirm hold fills while pressed and shows a check when the hold completes, as visual feedback only, so keep a confirmation in the Dynamic Action for destructive actions. |
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Visible button text and its accessible name. Use a specific verb, for example Create Order or Approve Invoice. Morph icon hides it visually until hover or focus, but screen readers always read it. |
| `linkUrl` | Link | sessionStateValue |  |  | Target URL, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:10:&SESSION. When set an anchor is rendered, otherwise a button for a Dynamic Action. Must be a developer-controlled value, never raw user input. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class, for example fa-plus or fa-trash. Morph icon, Magnetic float and Confirm hold draw an arrow when it is empty. |
| `hint` | Hint | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional short secondary text: the shortcut legend on Keycap, for example Ctrl S; the instruction under the label on Confirm hold, for example Hold to confirm; a small trailing tag in the other designs, for example New or 3. |
| `color` | Color | sessionStateValue |  | `primary` | Palette color: primary, success, warning, danger or info. Empty or any other value renders as primary. Can be static text or a column. Holo foil and Rainbow glow use the whole palette and take the color only for the focus ring and icon. |
| `size` | Size | selectList (`small`, `large`) |  |  | Leave empty for the default size, or choose Small or Large. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/next-button/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_next_button.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
